digest.component_or_area: Jira multi-project bridge test harness (live DC integration)
propositions: Real Jira rejects non-existent project keys with parse errors, causing inbound multi-project passes to abort entirely due to missing per-project exception handling
Two shared production Cloud projects are insufficient to model three distinct repo configurations, empty projects, and fail-closed unknown-project paths in isolation
Live Cloud rehearsal requires creation of throwaway scratch projects per run with random keys to prevent cross-run data contamination and verify true fail-closed behavior for absent projects
Multi-project mutations must be preview-gated to verify outbound operations target only their intended project with zero intersection against other configured projects
Synchronous index-lag in DC requires poll-based label settlement rather than plan-keyed waits in live sync assertions
Library exceptions raised in applier code must be wrapped and re-raised by the caller, requiring test assertions to match on wrapper exception types
